entries.name: ball.cfd.ball
entries.description: Get the pointer to the host mechanical ball.

entries.name: ball.cfd.elementmap
entries.description: Get the CFD element associated with a ball.

entries.name: ball.cfd.extra
entries.description: Get/set the CFD ball extra variable.

entries.name: ball.cfd.find
entries.description: Find a CFD ball.

entries.name: ball.cfd.force
entries.description: Get/set the CFD ball force.

entries.name: ball.cfd.force.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the CFD ball force.

entries.name: ball.cfd.force.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the CFD ball force.

entries.name: ball.cfd.force.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the CFD ball force.

entries.name: ball.cfd.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to CFD ball b in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: ball.cfd.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the CFD ball in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: ball.cfd.id
entries.description: Get the CFD ball ID.

entries.name: ball.cfd.inbox
entries.description: Get CFD balls with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the CFD ball. Specifying b = false indicates that only CFD balls with centroids falling in the box are returned.

entries.name: ball.cfd.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the CFD ball and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: ball.cfd.list
entries.description: Get the global CFD ball list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: ball.cfd.near
entries.description: Find the closest CFD ball to a point. If frad is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: ball.cfd.num
entries.description: Get the number of CFD balls.

entries.name: ball.cfd.pos
entries.description: Get/set the CFD ball position.

entries.name: ball.cfd.pos.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the CFD ball node position.

entries.name: ball.cfd.pos.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the CFD ball node position.

entries.name: ball.cfd.pos.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the CFD ball node position.

entries.name: ball.cfd.typeid
entries.description: Get the CFD ball type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify ball FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: ball.contact.list
entries.description: Get a list of active contacts around a ball. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: ball.contact.list.all
entries.description: Get a list of all contacts around a ball. Inactive contacts are included. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: ball.contactmap
entries.description: Get active contacts around a ball. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: ball.contactmap.all
entries.description: Get all contacts around a ball. Inactive contacts are included. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: ball.contactnum
entries.description: Get number of active contacts around a ball. The optional argument enables filtering by contact type.

entries.name: ball.contactnum.all
entries.description: Get number of contacts around a ball. Inactive contacts are included. The optional argument enables filtering by contact type.

entries.name: ball.containing
entries.description: Find the ball containing the point.

entries.name: ball.convergence
entries.description: Return the ball convergence. The convergence is the ratio of the current local force ratio (ball.ratio) to the target force ratio (ball.ratio.target). A value of 1 or less is considered “converged”.

entries.name: ball.create
entries.description: Create a ball.
entries.note: The first argument is the radius. The live 'fish list intrinsics' table prints ball.create(ball_pnt,vec3+,<int>); the manual gives ball.create(f,v<,i>) and ball.create(0.05, vector(0,0,0.9), 99999) creates a ball of radius 0.05 on PFC3D 6.00.30, 7.00.161 and 9.8.54 (2026-10-29).

entries.name: ball.damp
entries.description: Get/set ball local damping factor.

entries.name: ball.delete
entries.description: Delete a ball.

entries.name: ball.density
entries.description: Get/set ball density.

entries.name: ball.disp
entries.description: Get/set the ball displacement.

entries.name: ball.disp.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the ball displacement.

entries.name: ball.disp.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the ball displacement.

entries.name: ball.energy
entries.description: Get the ball total energy contribution. This is the sum over all balls of the energy with name s (see the model energy command). Available energies are: energy-body, energy-damp, and energy-kinetic.

entries.name: ball.euler
entries.description: Get/set the ball orientation. The convention \big\{X,Y^{'},Z^{''}\big\} is used (i.e., the x-, y-, and z-components correspond to the sequential rotations about the X, Y^{'}, and Z^{''} axes).

entries.name: ball.euler.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the ball orientation.

entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the ball orientation.

entries.name: ball.euler.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the ball orientation.

entries.name: ball.group

entries.name: ball.group.list
entries.description: Get a list of balls that belong to the group named s. The arguments s and slot may be specified as strings or indices*. If slot is not specified, then all slots are queried.

entries.name: ball.inside
entries.description: Test whether a point is inside a ball block.

entries.name: ball.isbonded
entries.description: Get the ball bonded state. This intrinsic checks the contact models of all active contacts with the ball for bonding. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: ball.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the ball and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.
